coverage_note: Public employees under HRS chapter 89. capitol.hawaii.gov answers this capture tool with a Cloudflare 403, so the statute text itself was not captured; cells rest on the Hawaii Labor Relations Board's rules (HAR chapter 12-43, effective October 21, 2022), captured as the Board's scanned PDF and read by OCR. Cells that need the statute text are null.
quote_normalization: quote_binding exact-substring is checked after Unicode NFC and collapsing every run of whitespace (including no-break space) to one space, in both the quote and the text extracted from the captured bytes (HTML: BeautifulSoup get_text; PDF: pdftotext)
provenance_id_canonicalization: provenance_id = 'prov-' + sha256 of the record serialized as JSON with sorted keys, separators (',', ':'), UTF-8, without the provenance_id field; re-fingerprint with scripts/lib/provenance.mjs once P0 lands
disclaimer: Reference summary of public law, not legal advice. Members with a specific case should talk to a steward or a lawyer.

impasse_procedure.value: Notice of impasse to the HLRB more than 90 days after either party's notice to negotiate, then the Board's mediation and, for units covered by HRS 89-11(e)(2), interest arbitration panels (HAR 12-43-112 to 12-43-123)
impasse_procedure.quote: More than ninety days after written notice by either party to initiate negotiations, either party may give written notice to the board that an impasse exists by filing with the board a notice of impasse
